prompts.name: 欧洲
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas, NOT a scene or moodboard. A single landscape PNG, exactly 1536 by 1024, true transparent background. Strict invisible 3 columns x 2 rows grid of equal 512 square cells. One fully isolated asset per cell, each contained inside its own cell with at least 32 px transparent margins. No text, labels, grid lines, frames, shadows spilling outside cell, people, or background scenery. Rich 1600s harbor HD-2D pixel-painted aesthetic: crisp small pixel clusters, detailed handcrafted materials, restrained natural colors, warm upper-left sunlight and cool deep occlusion. Slight elevated FRONT view (see building front and small right side and roof; no diamond isometric base). All assets share view and light.
Cell order left-to-right top-to-bottom:
1 TOP LEFT: a square patch of the specified pavement, viewed straight top-down, contained within central 448x448, square opaque footprint, no surrounding dirt vignette.
2 TOP MIDDLE: a complete freestanding two-storey regional house, base aligned near bottom of cell, no attached landscape.
3 TOP RIGHT: one full mature regional tree including trunk and foliage, no planter, small roots only.
4 BOTTOM LEFT: one regional market stand with fabric canopy, wooden supports, counter and goods, no people.
5 BOTTOM MIDDLE: a separate narrow horizontal strip of regional roof-edge wind decorations (hanging fringe, pennants or fabric), suspended from a thin rigid beam; transparent above and below, centered, intended to attach as separate animated layer to a house.
6 BOTTOM RIGHT: a single bird in flight, wide open wings extended horizontally, head faces right, visible from slightly above/side, fully isolated; no duplicates or motion trails.
Make all six items large and detailed but do not cross the grid boundaries. No baked ground shadows except intrinsic contact shading.
REGION: Temperate western European harbor: worn grey and warm ochre cobbles; cream plaster and dark half-timber house with steep reddish clay tile roof; mature broad oak; ochre and faded blue striped linen market awning with apples and barrels; short faded blue linen pennants hanging from an eave beam; white grey-winged gull.
